entries.en: Her enlightened approach encouraged junior staff to question old routines.
entries.zh: 她开明的做法鼓励初级员工质疑旧有惯例。

entries.en: She distrusted any explanation that sounded too convenient.
entries.zh: 她不信任任何听起来太便于开脱的解释。

entries.en: An elderly gent offered us his umbrella.
entries.zh: 一位老绅士表示愿意把自己的伞给我们用。

entries.en: The eel writhed inside the shallow bucket.
entries.zh: 鳗鱼在一个不深的桶里扭动。

entries.en: He sulked by the window after losing his place in the play.
entries.zh: 失去戏里的角色后，他在窗边生闷气。
